parameters.name: AllowModify
parameters.description: Indicates whether the configuration item can be modified.

parameters.name: ConfigKey
parameters.description: The key of the configuration item.

parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
The type of the configuration item. Valid values:

- FE

- BE

- CORE

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the configuration item's feature.

parameters.name: NeedTotal
parameters.description: Indicates whether to return all configuration items.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for the query. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. The default value is 20.
